{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999

# Count how many are in each arm
sentinel_by_arm = trial_df[sentinel_mask].groupby('arm').size()

# Compute the proportion of sentinel values in each arm
prop_sentinel_control = sentinel_by_arm['control'] / trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
prop_sentinel_treatment = sentinel_by_arm['treatment'] / trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]

# Manually compute chi-squared test for proportion difference
# Use the formula for two-proportion z-test
n_control = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
n_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]

p_control = prop_sentinel_control
p_treatment = prop_sentinel_treatment

p_pooled = (sentinel_by_arm['control'] + sentinel_by_arm['treatment']) / (n_control + n_treatment)

se_pooled = (p_pooled * (1 - p_pooled) * (1/n_control + 1/n_treatment)) ** 0.5
z = (p_control - p_treatment) / se_pooled
p_value = 2 * (1 - norm.cdf(abs(z)))

print(f'Proportion of sentinel values in control: {prop_sentinel_control:.3f}')
print(f'Proportion of sentinel values in treatment: {prop_sentinel_treatment:.3f}')
print(f'Z-score: {z:.3f}')
print(f'P-value: {p_value:.4f}')"}
